title: From Gaza to Iran, Children Have Always Been Sacrificed by Western Imperial Aims
author: Fatima Bhutto
content:

On the tenth of Ramadan, the holiest month of the year for Muslims, a US-
Israeli strike in the Iranian town of Minab slaughtered at least 165 people,
mostly girls between the ages of 7 and 12, who were at school, according to
[local media](https://x.com/DropSiteNews/status/2028184693464539362). In what
has been disturbingly commonplace over the last three years, while the
mainstream media contorted itself to report Israel's illegal bombing without
actually naming Israel, social media was filled with the nightmarish images of
small, pink backpacks covered in blood. I watched a father hold the severed
arm of a little girl up to the camera as he wept.

"I cannot understand how a place where innocent children learn can be bombed
like this," Mohammed Shariatmadar, whose young daughter, Sara, was killed in
the strike, told [Drop Site](https://www.dropsitenews.com/p/iran-minab-
elementary-girls-school-bombing-schoolgirls-killed-us-israel-
war?utm_campaign=post&utm_medium=web). "We are talking about small children
who knew nothing of politics or wars. And yet they are the ones paying the
highest price."

Sara was in the second grade.

It's unclear as of writing whether it was an Israeli or a US bomb that killed
scores of innocent children (Israeli propagandists' usual and flimsy
[claims](https://x.com/GeoConfirmed/status/2028088723770945712) that the
school was hit by a misfired Iranian missile have been debunked). This is an
illegal war of Israel and the US, and both deserve the blame. Their bloodlust
is insatiable.

Not content with their genocide against the Palestinians, they have now set
out to "liberate" Iranian women. Liberate them from what exactly? Hijabs,
Islam, a government they don't like, it doesn't really matter. They're
liberating them, and they will murder as many women and children as necessary
to do so. On day one, in Lamerd, at least 18 people, [many of them teenage
female volleyball players,](https://www.dropsitenews.com/p/iran-minab-
elementary-girls-school-bombing-schoolgirls-killed-us-israel-
war?utm_campaign=post&utm_medium=web) were reportedly killed in another
attack. When they assassinated Ayatollah Ali Khamenei, Iran's supreme leader -
another Israeli signature, remember when they murdered most of the Yemeni
cabinet? - they also killed his daughter and granddaughter. They
[reportedly](https://www.nytimes.com/2026/02/28/world/middleeast/iran-school-
strike-us-israel.html) hit another school - Hedayat High School in the
capital, Tehran - killing two students. On day two, as per the Israeli
playbook, they [bombed
near](https://x.com/DropSiteNews/status/2028115035877147088) the headquarters
of the Iranian Red Crescent.

Let us call things by their name: what kind of liberation can be claimed by a
state - Israel - that uses [rape as policy against the
people](https://www.ohchr.org/en/press-releases/2025/03/more-human-can-bear-
israels-systematic-use-sexual-reproductive-and-other) it occupies? Human
rights organizations have
[documented](https://www.btselem.org/press_releases/20260120_living_hell) the
widespread sexual abuse of Palestinians by Israeli soldiers in their torture
camps, checkpoints, and beyond, reportedly even training their [police dogs to
rape on command](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=FMClnrt6p1U). "Iran
understands it is fighting the Epstein class that either rapes little girls or
bombs little girls," Foad Izadi, a professor at the University of Tehran, said
on [television](https://www.instagram.com/reels/DVT528zCJAX/). It's quite
clear the rest of the world understands this, too. Well, most of the world.

Reza Pahlavi - who
[promised](https://www.jpost.com/international/article-883439) to recognize
Israel as soon as he's restored to the throne that his father was thrown off
of - [celebrated](https://x.com/PahlaviReza/status/2028216184076722537) the
thousands of bombs dropped on his countrymen while his daughter
[sent](https://x.com/NoorPahlavi/status/2027659400337625591) President Donald
Trump a "thank you" alongside a heart and crying emoji on X in response to his
declaration of war against her homeland. No Pahlavi tweeted a crying face for
the slain schoolgirls.

Israel has destroyed not only the rules-based order but also obliterated the
most basic rules of war - you don't attack children. You don't bomb schools.
Hospitals are not hit. Enemy combatants are deserving of medical treatment.
Journalists are allowed entry and safe passage to do their jobs. While
Benjamin Netanyahu, Israel's prime minister, pursued by the International
Criminal Court, lands in Germany, who refused to enforce the arrest warrant
for an accused war criminal, and Israelis post videos of themselves doing
[yoga](https://www.facebook.com/StandWithUs/videos/not-even-the-iranian-
regime-can-break-the-spirit-of-the-israeli-people-in-centra/2326485234525957/)
in their bunkers, the price of war will be paid by the most vulnerable:
children.

They have always been sacrificed by Western imperial aims.

In 1996, the then US ambassador to the United Nations, Madeleine Albright,
reflected on the deaths of 500,000 Iraqi children due to US sanctions on 60
Minutes. "The price… we think," she
[mused](https://www.aljazeera.com/opinions/2022/3/25/lets-remember-madeleine-
albright-as-who-she-really-was), "the price is worth it."

_**Fatima Bhutto** is an award-winning author and journalist. '[Gaza: The
